name: Novaya Teberda-Teberda High-Pressure Gas Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Novaya Teberda-Teberda High-Pressure Gas Pipeline, Karachaevsk-Teberda Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline
values.RouteNotes: No published GIS/map route found; trunk follows the Teberda River valley with two over-water crossings (Interfax 2019).

researcher_notes: NOT in GGIT snapshot 20260930 (no Teberda/Karachaevsk/Karachay string in any row; roster has no Karachay-Cherkess line) -> not matched_existing. Candidate name 'Novaya Teberda-Teberda' is a misnomer: Gazprom's own wording is the gas pipeline from GRS Karachaevsk to the city of Teberda (neftegaz.ru, Gazprom/Miller-Temrezov meeting 2022-09-29: 'В сентябре 2021 г. Газпром завершил ... от ГРС Карачаевск до г. Теберда ... протяженностью 25,9 км', 4,000+ households in Teberda, Nizhnyaya and Verkhnyaya Teberda; url_verifier OK, 25,9 found). Same 25.9 km high-pressure line in the Gazprom Mezhregiongaz Cherkessk release (Sept 2021; energyland.info, verified, names Novaya/Nizhnyaya/Verkhnyaya Teberda + Teberda). Independent corroboration: RIA interview with KChR head Temrezov 2021-11-26 ('межпоселковый газопровод высокого давления Карачаевск - Теберда ... порядка 26 километров', commissioned September) and Vesti Kavkaza press review (Novak: inter-settlement pipeline from GRS Karachaevsk to Teberda commissioned, Sept 2021). Construction start: Interfax 2019-12-25 (Wayback; origin behind servicepipe bot wall, snapshot only): Gazprom began phase 2 in Aug 2018; ConstructionYear=2018. SCOPE/LENGTH FLAG: the same Interfax piece gives 46.5 km total Karachaevsk-Teberda, of which 22.5 km was phase 1 (2012-13, GRS Karachaevsk-Novaya Teberda-Nizhnyaya Teberda); 46.5-22.5 = 24 km does not equal 25.9, and Gazprom/RIA frame 25.9/~26 km as the whole GRS-Karachaevsk-to-Teberda project. Row staged at the sourced 25.9 km figure as the 2021 Novaya Teberda/Nizhnyaya Teberda-Teberda build (>=25 km floor met, only just); the phase-1 22.5 km (2012-13, GRS Karachaevsk-Nizhnyaya Teberda) is a separate possible never-captured row, unresearched (length <25 km -> monitor on length). Reviewer should decide whether to keep these as one 46.5 km line or two segments; if merged, LengthKnown becomes 46.5 with the Interfax ref. Diameter, capacity, pressure (MPa), cost: not found in any source -> blank (no orphan values). Type: inter-settlement high-pressure feeder (distribution-grade, comparable to P0743/P0744 in scope); owner/builder Gazprom PJSC via Gazprom Mezhregiongaz (customer) / Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Cherkessk (GDO); entity_lookup: 'Gazprom PJSC' exists (reuse); no entity for Gazprom Mezhregiongaz. Threshold: (a) sponsor Gazprom, (b) endpoints GRS Karachaevsk-Teberda, (c) built and commissioned Sept 2021, (d) 25.9 km sourced -> new_row (operating line GEM never captured). Tier medium: one Gazprom-origin length figure republished (neftegaz + Mezhregiongaz release), independent RIA says ~26 km; length scope ambiguity vs 46.5 km. Blocked/unciteable: tass.ru (403), mrg.gazprom.ru (timeout), interfax-russia.ru direct (bot wall) - not cited directly. Route: none found; Teberda river valley, two over-water crossings; no coordinates fabricated.
